name: KING
source: After the death of his father, Daisuke takes over his company. However, his time in charge is short lived as the company completely collapses after a series of betrayals and the devious plotting of the head of a rival company. He tries to save the company to no avail and ends up falling into a coma. In that state, he has a dream in which he meets his longtime companion, a doberman named King. When he awakens from the dream, he finds himself in King’s body. Even more surprising, he discovers he can transform back into his human form. Now Daisuke has only one thought on his mind: revenge. He wants to get back at the men responsible for taking everything from him, and what better way to do that than going after the girl each of them most cherishes?
